training: Fixed existing data; internal holdout of 200 disjoint queries; 3 seeds, evaluate all160 epochs; choose seed+epoch on internal loss only; refit all1200 training queries using selected seed, epoch and fixed LR schedule. No external validation/test used for fitting or checkpoint selection.
limits: Same finite training examples; longer training does not add query diversity
Gate uses contribution proxy retain labels, not counterfactual recall risk
ET labels are absolute prefix GT recall
